title: 5. Relational JOINs
description: Connect order history with customer profiles. Show order details alongside customer names.
objective: Select Orders.id, Customers.name, and Orders.total by joining Orders with Customers on customer_id.
targetQuery: SELECT Orders.id, Customers.name, Orders.total FROM Orders JOIN Customers ON Orders.customer_id = Customers.id;
